notes: Assumptions that change the number: 1 l full-cream milk; the cinnamon stick is lifted out; the vanilla's alcohol bakes off, so 25 % of its energy is kept; the jam layer and meringue (170 g sugar in all) are eaten in full. Sanity check: Woolworths sago pudding is 118 kcal / 100 g (FatSecret ZA), with no jam layer or meringue; ours is ~164 kcal / 100 g (2295 kcal over ~1.4 kg baked). The difference is the 80 g jam and the 90 g sugar meringue, ~540 kcal of the batch.
